author: Praxis III
title: Winsor‑DAQB: Per‑gene winsorization (1–99%) + BRBG + DAQB (k=48)
abstract: Mild per‑gene winsorization (1–99%) on HVG log1p counts before PCA_graph, then BRBG residualization and DAQB (δ=0.10, kd=20, k=48). Embedding remains EtC (FWPCA→ComBat). Hypothesis: trimming heavy tails stabilizes PCs without harming biological structure.
